_comment: A MANIFEST is a small structured record of exploration state, saved to disk. If a long session crashes or you close it, you can resume by loading this manifest instead of re-exploring everything from scratch. This is an EXAMPLE of what a filled-in manifest looks like.

modules_reviewed.purpose: entry point; loads one source; asks Claude

still_to_explore: how the single source is chosen
key_findings: all source I/O goes through retrieval._sources_dir()
retrieval returns structured {ok, results/error_type} results (Part 3 style)
